Pages in this category have been marked for deletion. For example, they could contain irrelevant or outdated data, have nonsense titles, be duplicate articles, or be unneeded redirects.

To mark a page for deletion, and have it automatically added to this category, type either <code><nowiki>{{deletion}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{del}}</nowiki></code> at the top of the page. If the page is a redirect, remove the redirect code. This will automatically flag an article for deletion, placing it in this category and leaving a notice on the article itself.

If possible, please provide a '''reason''' when using <nowiki>{{deletion}}</nowiki> or <nowiki>{{del}}</nowiki>, by adding a piped comment.

:''Example:''
::<nowiki>{{del| This is an example deletion request}}</nowiki> 
::::will produce...

{{del| This is an example deletion request|cat=nocat}}
